description: Premium scroll-driven landing pages. Scroll is the timeline: video scrubs, sections pin, rails pan, headlines assemble, the ground shifts colour. Interviews first, then locks a page grammar, one feeling peak, a signature move, and a fingerprint so two builds cannot share a skeleton. Use when the user or seat wants scrollytelling, an Apple-style landing, a unique scroll site, or when a template-looking page must be rejected.
